simple.meaning: נָסַס (nâçaç) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to wane , i.e. be sick.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 1 time in Isaiah, beginning at Isaiah 10:18. Its meaning becomes clearer as the uses are compared.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to נָסַס (H5263) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: נָסַס (nâçaç) / H5263 is traced through Isaiah 10:18 with source-language evidence and verse context.
